profile.headline: Software Engineer at Perforce
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer, I have a solid Operations/Linux System Administration background, which has honed my skills in troubleshooting and debugging. I am highly committed to solving any task or problem at hand and take full ownership of the products I work on. My expertise lies in balancing quality and velocity while delivering features, without compromising on the alignment with our product and business objectives.

I am a detail-oriented individual who strives to deliver direct customer value by working on challenging technical problems. I take great satisfaction in tackling projects that are both technically interesting and have a direct impact on the customer experience.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Assisted in onboarding the Belfast-based team and provided training to help them contribute to the CD4PE (Continuous Delivery for Puppet Enterprise) product.

- Led a project to revamp the installation and management experience of CD4PE, resulting in a significant improvement in the overall customer experience.

- Provided technical leadership to the rest of the CD4PE team.

- Presented  architectural reviews of the CD4PE product to the Perforce CTO and engineers across the org.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the development of a REST API for our CD4PE product, which included implementing an OpenApi/Swagger spec and an auto-generated TypeScript client for the frontend. On the backend, JAX-RS server stubs were built on Jersey. The project was successfully completed under my leadership.

- Managed a project that involved replacing the RBAC feature of the product. This required extensive coordination with cross-functional teams and a comprehensive reassertion of the feature requirements. The project was executed successfully under my guidance.

- Provided technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, helping them acquire the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in their roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the development of the "License Server" service, which provides a user portal for purchasing licenses for various Puppet products.

- Collaborated on the development of the "Pipelines for Containers" product, which serves as a Kubernetes management platform. During this project, I gained valuable experience in working with Helm and created an integration for performing Helm chart deployments. Additionally, I developed a strong understanding of Kubernetes and its APIs through Java programming.

- Made significant contributions to the "Continuous Delivery for Puppet Enterprise" product by implementing various high-value features. Some of my notable contributions include integrating an LDAP/Active Directory authentication system, supporting multiple VCS providers, refactoring a significant amount of legacy code, and performing scale testing utilizing AWS EC2. Furthermore, I developed a migration feature to seamlessly transfer customer data to new installations and created front-end automation tests to ensure product reliability.

positions.title: Operations Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded a data analytics project aimed at enhancing throughput in a complex CI pipeline matrix by gathering and analyzing large amounts of data from product test suites. Developed a custom Jenkins plugin to export CI run data to Google BigQuery, leveraging Google Data Studio to visualize data insights. Later transitioned to Looker for better visualizations. This project provided valuable exposure to data engineering methodologies and practices.

- Automated the deployment of monitoring infrastructure by writing Puppet code. This involved designing and implementing a solution to efficiently manage and monitor large-scale systems across multiple environments.

- Oversaw the management of Elasticsearch infrastructure for logging, ensuring that logs were properly indexed and readily accessible to stakeholders. This included identifying and addressing performance issues and configuring security policies to protect sensitive data.

- Managed Graphite metrics infrastructure to monitor system performance and identify areas for optimization. This required a deep understanding of data visualization and analysis techniques, as well as expertise in implementing scalable solutions.

- Administered systems for test infrastructure to support development and testing of critical systems. This involved deploying and maintaining test environments, identifying and troubleshooting issues, and working collaboratively with development teams to ensure smooth operation.

- Maintained and optimized corporate network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure connectivity across all systems and users. This involved implementing security protocols and access controls, monitoring network performance, and identifying and addressing potential vulnerabilities.

positions.title: Web Operations Engineer - Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to a project to perform log aggregation for multiple web applications. This project involved designing and deploying a centralized logging solution that improved visibility into system events and enabled faster troubleshooting.

- Collaborated with senior engineers to deploy and maintain web applications across a large-scale infrastructure, identifying and resolving issues that arose during the process. This involved providing technical support to developers, troubleshooting bugs, and ensuring optimal system performance.

- Supported the development team by providing technical guidance and assistance with web application deployment, including optimizing infrastructure and troubleshooting complex issues. This required a deep understanding of both the technical details of the applications as well as the underlying infrastructure.

positions.title: Student System Administrator
positions.description: Maintained infrastructure for hosting open source software.

company.name: Oregon State University Open Source Lab
